# Verification Universe

Evidence is the keli; confidence alone cannot be the light.

## Static
- `node --check` every touched `.js`/`.mjs` file.
- Assert no new source file exceeds 120 lines unless data-only structure makes splitting demonstrably worse.
- Assert tabs for indentation in touched executable source.
- Assert headers/JSDoc presence required by the project constitution.

## Protocol
- Valid mixed movie normalizes and validates.
- Invalid duration, duplicate IDs and out-of-bounds scenes fail with useful errors.
- Sampling at 0, scene boundaries, middle and 179.999 seconds resolves deterministically.
- Keyframe interpolation handles linear/ease/hold semantics.
- AI contract serializes without functions or browser globals.

## Showcase
- Exact duration 180 seconds.
- Multiple distinct scenes and camera angles.
- 2D shapes, text, paths/patches, charts and particles.
- 3D declarations, camera depth/movement, lights/world objects where supported.
- Recurring people/characters with continuity metadata.
- Tutorial and infographic sequences in addition to narrative scenes.

## Adapters
- Captions adapter reports its 2D strengths and preserves unsupported 3D layers.
- Nesher adapter creates edit/timeline-oriented records without losing source provenance.
- Animator adapter preserves semantic camera/character/3D intent for cinematic realization.

## Runtime
- Load relevant apps at desktop and narrow mobile widths.
- No new console exceptions.
- Controls remain reachable and viewport-safe.
- Existing app-specific focused regression tests pass.

## Render Evidence
- Produce actual media artifact when existing project exporter supports the document path.
- `ffprobe` duration approximately 180.000 seconds with expected video stream.
- Inspect representative frames from opening, middle and ending, plus at least one infographic and character scene.
- Record command outputs and artifact path in final evidence note.
